subject: ImmunoWave — next step: 30-min demo & timing options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Lowe <megan@immunowave.com>, Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@immunowave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: ImmunoWave — next step: 30-min demo & timing options

Hi Megan / Carlos,

Thanks again for the time today — helpful to learn about the latency-sensitive annotator pipeline and the desire to centralize inference for multi-region failover. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: You want a hosted endpoint with private VPC peering, predictable latency under 120ms p90, and audit logs retained for 13 months.
- Success criteria we agreed: end-to-end demo of 30-min product preview showing (1) end-user flow, (2) routing policy failover, and (3) cost/perf tradeoffs with our quantized variants.
- Security note: you mentioned an internal SOC 2 checklist — happy to bring a short security appendix to the demo.

To book the 30-min demo, can you please pick 2–3 windows that work for the core stakeholders (product, infra/SRE, and security/compliance)? Below are a few windows in PT next week to consider — if none work, send two that do and I’ll follow up with a calendar invite.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Oct 6: 10:00–10:30 AM
- Wed, Oct 7: 2:30–3:00 PM
- Thu, Oct 8: 11:00–11:30 AM

Attendees we suggest including: Megan (PM), Carlos (CTO/SRE), 1 security/compliance lead. On our side I’ll include Priyom (SE) and Monica (CSM) so we can handle the infra and onboarding questions live.

Prep attachments: I’ve attached a 1-page demo agenda and a mutual action plan (stub) so we can align owners before the call. If there are any specific compliance docs you’d like in advance (SOC 2 excerpts, retention policy), flag them and we’ll include them in the invite.

Next steps: Reply with preferred windows and stakeholder names; I’ll lock the slot and send an invite with the agenda.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: MVP-demo-agenda.docx (docx, 1 page), MutualActionPlan.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)
From: Megan Lowe <megan@immunowave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@immunowave.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 17:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ImmunoWave — next step: 30-min demo & timing options

Thanks, Jonas — great summary.

We can do Tuesday or Thursday next week. Our preference is Tue, Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PT but if you need to move, Thu 11:00 AM PT also works.

Attendees on our side: myself (PM), Carlos (CTO), and I’ll loop in Lena Ho (Security Lead). I’ve cc’d Carlos here to confirm.

Quick Qs before we lock: 
1) Do you need any IP or sample data from us for the demo? We can provide a small anonymized sample if it helps illustrate routing/latency.
2) Any specific cloud region requirements? We run experiments primarily in us-west-2.

If we do Tue at 10 I’ll ask Lena to join. If Lena cannot make it we may ask for a 15-min follow-up deeper into the SOC questions.

—Megan
Megan Lowe
Product Lead, Integrations | ImmunoWave
megan@immunowave.com

Perfect — thanks Megan. Locking Tue, Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min preview. I’ll send a calendar invite in a moment (provisional until Lena confirms).

Plan for the session: 30 minutes total
- 0–6m quick context and success criteria confirmation (Jonas + Megan)
- 6–18m product demo focused on routing, latency, and KV cache behavior (Priyom)
- 18–26m discussion: infra mapping and next steps (Carlos + security)
- 26–30m confirm mutual action plan and owners (all)

I added Priyom and Monica on the cc — Priyom can bring a simple infra diagram and we’ll include a short security appendix. Attached an .ics stub and I’ll follow with the actual Google invite once Lena is confirmed.

If Lena isn’t available we can proceed and schedule a 15-min SOC sync afterwards — either way we’ll keep the demo to the 30-min window.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Adding a quick prep checklist for Tue (internal):
- Slides: 6–8 slides (context, demo steps, infra diagram, security appendix). Priyom to own slides 6–18m.
- Live infra diagram: show us-west-2 baseline + routing fallback to us-east-1.
- Test data: use small anonymized sample (ImmunoWave to confirm) — fallback to our synthetic dataset if needed.
- Invites: Jonas to send calendar; include Lena (security) as optional.
- Meeting link: use GMeet, include recording and post-call notes link to HubSpot.

I’ll prepare the infra diagram and the short demo script tonight and share with Monica for run-through.
